description: Divisional Secretariat  of Manmunai South West - Notify the Annual Festival of the Kokkaddicholai  Sri Thanthonriswarar  Temple -2018
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the dates for a religious festival (Sri Thanthonriswarar Temple Annual Festival) and references regulations from a previous gazette. The content deals with cultural/religious event administration and public notifications, which does not fit any of the specialized categories (4-9) and is not related to government structure/personnel (Types 1-3). Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous as cultural/administrative matter.
